selection_reasoning: These three tasks form a coherent multi-hop dependency chain centered around building a garden. First, the agent must find coarse_dirt (a soil/terrain block useful for planting). Second, the agent must find a flower_pot (a decorative container for plants). Finally, with knowledge of where these garden-related items are located, the agent must 'Build a garden' which logically requires both the coarse dirt (as a planting medium/ground) and the flower pot (as a decorative garden element). This creates a natural convergent DAG where two independent find tasks feed into a construction task. The tasks are observable, verifiable, and don't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — they involve navigation, identification, and placement.

Building a garden requires finding the flower_pot to place as a decorative planting container in the garden

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the coarse_dirt patch (centered at ~4, ~-1, ~4) and face toward it, modeling 'player can see the target'. max_distance=8 ensures the player walked toward the patch (at least ~2 blocks from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the flower_pot at ~-4, ~0, ~3 and face toward it. max_distance=8 ensures meaningful navigation from spawn (the pot is ~5 blocks west), and facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the small flower_pot block.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because this is a place/build task. Two rules check that the player placed at least 2 dandelions AND at least 1 flower_pot in the garden zone on the coarse_dirt patch. The box [1,0,1]-[7,0,7] generously covers the 5x5 coarse_dirt area (at ~2-6) with ±1 padding. No pre-existing dandelions or flower_pots exist in this box (the pre-placed flower_pot is at ~-4,0,3 which is far outside), so any detection is definitively player-placed.

scene_description: A flat grass area with a coarse_dirt garden patch (5x5 at ~2-6, y-1, ~2-6) with an oak fence enclosure (empty, no pre-placed flowers). A flower_pot is placed at ~-4,0,3 surrounded by 4 oak fence posts on the west side. The player has dandelions (6), flower_pots (3), oak_fences (8), coarse_dirt (8), and bone_meal (4) in inventory to build a garden. The two find tasks require locating the coarse_dirt patch and flower_pot, then the build task requires placing dandelions and a flower_pot in the garden zone.
task_text: First, find the coarse dirt patch on the ground to the east. Then, find the flower pot placed near the fences to the west. Finally, build a garden on the dirt patch by placing at least 2 dandelions and 1 flower pot inside the fenced area.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at origin on grass. Coarse dirt 5x5 patch at ~2-6, y-1, ~2-6 (east). Flower pot at ~-4,0,3 (west) surrounded by 4 fence posts. Garden enclosure (fences only, NO pre-placed flowers) at ~3-5,0,3-5 on the coarse dirt. Player has only dandelions and flower_pots for building (no poppies/tulips to avoid ambiguity). Pre-placed dandelion removed so any flower in garden zone = player-placed. Bone meal included for optional grass/flower growing.
